# MSI (imzML) demo fixture

Files here back the spatial-lipidomics (mass-spectrometry-imaging) demo and tests.

- `demo_brain.imzML` / `demo_brain.ibd` — a small MSI acquisition.
- `annotations.csv` — companion ion table (`name`, `mz`, `adduct`) mapping m/z peaks
  to lipid names. imzML itself carries no names, so this is what the ingestion joins
  on before standardization.

## Provenance

**These committed files are SYNTHETIC**, generated by
[`scripts/make_synth_msi_demo.py`](../../../../../scripts/make_synth_msi_demo.py): a
tissue-like elliptical region (~800 pixels) with distinct per-lipid spatial patterns.
They use **real lipid names** and plausible `[M+H]+` m/z (several participate in
BioPAN reactions — PC/PE/PA/DG/LPC — so the reaction-overlay demo works), but the
intensities are simulated. This keeps the demo and CI fully offline.

## Using a real open-data slice instead

[`scripts/fetch_msi_demo.py`](../../../../../scripts/fetch_msi_demo.py) downloads a
real public **METASPACE** lipidomics dataset, exports its annotations, subsamples a
small pixel region, and overwrites the files here with a real slice.

⚠️ **Check the source dataset's license before committing any real slice** (METASPACE
datasets are commonly CC-BY but not universally). Record the dataset ID, DOI, and
license in this README when you replace the synthetic fixture.
